channel.title: News - National Crime Agency
channel.description: The National Crime Agency leads the UK's fight to cut serious and organised crime.

item.title: Operation Venetic: Drugs and firearms suppliers convicted
item.description: Two men who supplied pistols and ammunition to organised crime groups have been convicted and sentenced.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: New website launched for victims and survivors of child sexual abuse and exploitation
item.description: A new website providing victims and survivors of child sexual abuse and exploitation with information and support, as well as options in relation to requesting a review of a previously closed case, has been launched today.
item.author: cms23@nca.gov.uk (cms-user23)

item.title: Boats destined for people smugglers seized at East Midlands Airport
item.description: NCA and Border Force officers have seized 25 inflatable boats that were destined to be shipped to cross-Channel people smugglers.
item.author: cms27@nca.gov.uk (cms-user27)
